items.title: Organization-linked Activation Lock for iOS, configuration profile deployment wizard and wallpaper image size improvement, Android kiosk mode bug fix
items.text:
In this article
Toggle
Organization-linked Activation Lock for iOS
We implemented support for organization-linked Activation Lock for iPhone and iPad devices. You can now enable and disable organization-linked Activation lock remotely using Miradore.
For detailed information on organization-linked Activation Lock, see Activation Lock for iOS devices.
Configuration profile deployment wizard improvement
We replaced the step-by-step wizard for the Deploy configuration profile action available from the Management > Devices page and individual device pages with a modern dialog. The new dialog only appears on the Management > Devices page if a single device is selected. If multiple devices are selected, the previous wizard is used.
Wallpaper image size increase for iOS and Android
We increased the image file size limit from 1 MB to 2 MB for the Set wallpaper action for iOS and Android devices.
For instructions on setting a wallpaper on your devices remotely, see Set or change wallpaper on Android devices and Set a custom wallpaper on iOS devices.
Bug fix for exiting kiosk mode on Android devices during remote sessions
We fixed a bug where remotely viewing the screen of an Android device in kiosk mode showed a black screen when trying to enter the security code to exit kiosk mode. With the fix, the security code input field remains masked to hide the characters, but the screen is no longer entirely hidden.

items.title: Credential manager policy configuration profile for Android, Set wallpaper and Merge devices dialog improvement, bug fix for Wi-Fi configuration profile for iOS and macOS
items.text:
In this article
Toggle
Credential manager policy configuration profile for Android
We added a new Credential manager policy configuration profile for Android devices. This configuration profile allows you to control which credential provider apps device users can use. For detailed information and instructions, see Create a Credential manager policy configuration profile for Android devices.
Set wallpaper and Merge devices dialog improvement
We replaced the step-by-step wizards of the Set wallpaper (iOS and Android) and Merge devices (Android and Windows) actions with modern dialogs.
Bug fix for Wi-Fi configuration profile for iOS and macOS
We fixed a bug where defining a Minimum TLS version and Maximum TLS version for the WPA/WPA2 (Enterprise) and WPA3 (Enterprise) security modes for the iOS and macOS Wi-Fi configuration profile resulted in the TLS version values not being saved. With the fix, the configuration profile correctly saves and loads the minimum and maximum TLS version settings and applies them to the devices.

items.title: UI theme selector in the MSP Portal
items.text:
We added a new Theme selector to the MSP Portal to allow you to customize the design of the UI. The Theme selector, available in the top-right corner, offers the following settings:
Light: The UI appears with a light-colored background and dark-colored text and icons.
Dark: The UI appears with a dark-colored background and light-colored text and icons.
System: The UI follows the light or dark theme setting of your device or your browser if device settings are overwritten by browser settings.
Sites page using Light theme
Sites page using Dark theme
Additionally, you can change the website theme on the login screen by choosing an option in the top-right corner.
Theme selector on the login screen
Note: If you experience any visual issues following this update, we recommend clearing your browser's cookies and cache.

items.title: Miradore client update for Android, bulk selection for Allow managed Google Play application installation dialog
items.text:
In this article
Toggle
Miradore client update for Android
We updated the Miradore client for Android devices to version 2.18.9 (Build 469). This update does not introduce any new functionality, but is needed to support Android 16 and future updates. As always, we recommend you update the Miradore client app on your managed devices to version 2.18.9 (Build 469).
Bulk selection for Allow managed Google Play application installation dialog
We updated the Allow managed Google Play application installation dialog available from the Managed Google Play menu on the device details pages of Android devices to include a checkbox to select all apps. This way, you can conveniently select all available apps to be allowed to be installed on your managed Android devices with a single click. For more information on allowing managed Google Play app installation, see Allow application installation and configure user access to the managed Google Play store.
